caption: The drawing depicts a single, metallic lantern positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The lantern is rectangular with slightly weathered surfaces, exhibiting a combination of greenish, brown, and blue tones that suggest oxidized metal. Metal rods run diagonally in an 'X' formation across the visible front and side panels, providing structural detail. The top of the lantern features a cylindrical, scalloped-edge cap, also rendered in a metallic, grayish hue. Above the cap is a circular handle, depicted in an upright position. Shadows and color variations indicate the lantern's three-dimensional form, with no additional objects or embellishments present in the composition.
title: Lantern
